questions.stem: Identify all neuroglial cells residing in the Central Nervous System (CNS): (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: CNS neuroglia = Astrocytes, Oligodendrocytes, Microglia, Ependymal. Schwann = PNS.

questions.stem: Identify all characteristics belonging to Red Muscle fibres: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Red muscle is rich in myoglobin/mitochondria, slow-twitch, aerobic.

questions.stem: Identify all tissue macrophages derived from blood monocytes: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Kupffer, Microglia, Dust cells, Langerhans are specialized monocyte-derived histocytes.

questions.stem: Identify all features distinguishing Cardiac Muscle from Skeletal Muscle: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Cardiac muscle is involuntary, branched, has intercalated discs, fatigue-resistant.

questions.stem: Identify all factors required during blood clotting cascade to form Fibrin: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Clotting requires Thromboplastin, Ca2+, Prothrombin, Thrombin, Fibrinogen.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Hard deck, select all true statements regarding Synaptic Transmission in neurones: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Action potential arrives at presynaptic axon terminal knob
B) Voltage-gated Ca2+ channels open triggering neurotransmitter exocytosis
C) Neurotransmitters diffuse across synaptic cleft
D) Binding to postsynaptic receptors generates graded potential
E) Electrical synapses utilize Nissl's granules for signal transmission
answers: A) Action potential arrives at presynaptic axon terminal knob
B) Voltage-gated Ca2+ channels open triggering neurotransmitter exocytosis
C) Neurotransmitters diffuse across synaptic cleft
D) Binding to postsynaptic receptors generates graded potential
questions.explanation: Chemical synaptic transmission involves Ca2+ influx, neurotransmitter release, diffusion, and receptor binding.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Hard deck, select all physiological mechanisms operating in Single-Unit vs Multi-Unit Smooth Muscle: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Single-unit smooth muscle cells are electrically coupled via gap junctions
B) Single-unit smooth muscle exhibits myogenic pacemaker activity
C) Multi-unit smooth muscle cells are neurogenic and independently innervated
D) Multi-unit smooth muscle occurs in ciliary body of eye and arrector pili
E) Multi-unit smooth muscle contracts as a single synchronized syncytium
answers: A) Single-unit smooth muscle cells are electrically coupled via gap junctions
B) Single-unit smooth muscle exhibits myogenic pacemaker activity
C) Multi-unit smooth muscle cells are neurogenic and independently innervated
D) Multi-unit smooth muscle occurs in ciliary body of eye and arrector pili
questions.explanation: Single-unit is myogenic with gap junctions; multi-unit is neurogenic with independent cell units.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Hard deck, select all structural features of Intercalated Discs in cardiac muscle: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Transverse Fascia Adherens anchor actin filaments
B) Macula Adherens (Desmosomes) prevent cell separation during contraction
C) Longitudinal Gap Junctions transmit electrical action potential impulses
D) Permits functional syncytial contraction of myocardium
E) Tight junctions (Zona Occludens) blocking all ionic movement
answers: A) Transverse Fascia Adherens anchor actin filaments
B) Macula Adherens (Desmosomes) prevent cell separation during contraction
C) Longitudinal Gap Junctions transmit electrical action potential impulses
D) Permits functional syncytial contraction of myocardium
questions.explanation: Intercalated discs feature fascia adherens, desmosomes, and gap junctions for cardiac syncytium.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Hard deck, select all cellular characteristics of Plasma Cells in connective tissue: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Differentiated from active B-lymphocytes upon antigen encounter
C) Abundant rough endoplasmic reticulum for immunoglobulin synthesis
D) Synthesize and secrete circulating humoral antibodies
E) Phagocytose bacterial debris via lysosomal enzymes
answers: A) Differentiated from active B-lymphocytes upon antigen encounter
C) Abundant rough endoplasmic reticulum for immunoglobulin synthesis
D) Synthesize and secrete circulating humoral antibodies
questions.explanation: Plasma cells stem from B-lymphocytes, have cartwheel nuclei, abundant RER, and synthesize antibodies.

questions.stem: In Question Bank Hard deck, select all characteristics of Astrocyte neuroglia in the CNS: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Star-shaped glial cells with multiple radiating processes
B) Form perivascular end-feet surrounding brain capillaries
C) Constitute physical structural Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB)
D) Regulate extracellular K+ ion concentration and glutamate uptake
E) Synthesize myelin sheath around CNS axon fibers
answers: A) Star-shaped glial cells with multiple radiating processes
B) Form perivascular end-feet surrounding brain capillaries
C) Constitute physical structural Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB)
D) Regulate extracellular K+ ion concentration and glutamate uptake
questions.explanation: Astrocytes are star-shaped, form BBB perivascular feet, and balance ionic/glutamate homeostasis. Oligodendrocytes synthesize CNS myelin.
